page.layout: One printed page, a title page, set centred. Top: a line of show-through (mirrored text from the reverse, not transcribed). Centre: a library stamp (excluded). Below the stamp: author's line, a publisher's device (woodcut), the publisher's name and place, and the date at the foot.

main_text.l: S. Theol. D. Et Ling. Orient. & Hebr. Prof. Ord.

page.notes: Much of the title is only show-through from the reverse, mirrored and faint; those lines are left out. The title line "Moderna Theologia Iudaica" is partly legible, and the author's name and the Orientalia line are uncertain. The date "M DC XCIV" is doubtful. The library stamp ("Bibliotheca Regia Monacensis") and the publisher's device are not transcribed.
